rows.text: takes `n = 00265860()`; when `n` is 0 tail-jumps `0024EB20`; otherwise, when qword `02B58C48` is null, stores `002F16B0()` there and writes into that record qword `+0x10` = `003DE160`, qword `+8` = `003DE1F0`, dword `+4` = `n`, dword `+0x28` = 1 and byte `+0x20` = 0, and when it is non-null returns untouched

takes `n = 00265860()`; when `n` is 0 tail-jumps `0024EC00` with `rcx` = `02B58C38`; otherwise, when qword `02B58C48` is null, stores `002F16B0()` there and writes into that record qword `+0x10` = `003DE160`, qword `+8` = `003DE1F0`, dword `+4` = `n`, dword `+0x28` = 0 and byte `+0x20` = 0, and when it is non-null returns untouched
stores into byte `02B58C39` a value chosen by `ecx`: 1 maps to 2, 2 to 3, 3 to 0, and 0 or any other value to 1
stores into byte `02B58C3A` a value chosen by `ecx`: 0 to 3 are stored as they are and any other value stores 0
stores into byte `02B58C38` a value chosen by `ecx`: 1 maps to 2, 2 to 3, and 0 or any other value to 1
when `ecx` is non-zero stores 2 in byte `02B58C3B` and keeps it when `ecx` is 1; any other value (including 0) ends with 1 stored there
stores `cl`, `dl`, `r8b` and `r9b` in the bytes `02B59D3C`, `02B59D3D`, `02B59D3E` and `02B59D3F`
stores `cl`, `dl`, `r8b` and `r9b` in the bytes `02B59D40`, `02B59D41`, `02B59D42` and `02B59D43`
replaces bit 0 of byte `02B59D21` with 1 when `ecx` is non-zero and 0 when it is 0, keeping the other bits (old byte AND `0xFE`, OR the `setne` result)
stores the float `xmm0` in dword `02B59D24` and the float `xmm1` in dword `02B59D28`
stores into byte `02B59D20` a value chosen by `ecx`: 0 to 4 are stored as they are and any other value stores 2
stores the float `xmm0` in dword `02B59D34` and the float `xmm1` in dword `02B59D38`

notes: 003DE240/003DE2A0: 00265860 and 002F16B0 are called with the incoming registers in place but no visible argument setup, so they are written with empty argument lists; for 003DE240 the tail jump to 0024EB20 sets no rcx, so no argument is named. 003DF9F0: an unmatched value and the value 2 share the store of 2 at 003DFA18. 003DF950, 003DF970, 003DF9C0, 003DFA30: the first store is the entry instruction itself, so the anchors cover only the remaining stores; FABLE may prefer to skip 003DF9C0 and 003DFA30 (two-instruction bodies) if a single interior store is judged too thin.
